attempted_claim: Let H^2 be the hyperbolic plane of curvature -1 with stationary Poisson-Voronoi tessellation of intensity lambda>0 and Palm typical edge E_lambda on the edge skeleton with hyperbolic length len(E_lambda). Determine uniform exponential tail bounds plus a certified median interval: prove there exist explicit constants C,c>0 and t0>0 such that P(len(E_lambda)>t) <= C*exp(-c*lambda*t^2) for all lambda>0 and all t>=t0/sqrt(lambda) with t<=1, establish finite exponential moments, and evaluate the median m_1=median(len(E_1)) within a stated rigorous interval of half-width at most 0.05. A complete answer proves the uniform bound via hyperbolic void-probability envelopes without evaluating the full edge-length distribution function, certifies the median interval by stated integral bounds, and checks the Euclidean high-intensity limit.
